name: Sweet-Sour Macerated Cherries With Marcona Almonds, Mint, and Ricotta

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, toss together cherries, honey, and vinegar. Season with salt and a generous grating of pepper.

Spoon ricotta cheese into bowls (alternatively, spread it on toasted bread). Top with cherries and the macerating liquid, crushed almonds, and mint leaves. Sprinkle with flaky salt, if using, and serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: cherries, cherry recipe, macerated cherries, fruit salad

description: In this incredibly easy no-cook recipe, macerated fresh cherries are treated with a sweet-sour mixture of honey and red wine vinegar, then topped with black pepper and served with good ricotta cheese, crushed marcona almonds, and mint.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Toasted crusty bread, for serving (optional); Fresh mint leaves, for garnish; Flaky salt, such as Maldon (optional)

Notes: It's important to seek out high-quality fresh ricotta cheese, since the mass-market brands usually found at supermarkets won't perform well in this simple recipe.
If you don't have Marcona almonds, substitute an equal quantity of macadamia nuts.
author: Daniel Gritzer
